mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_weight_log (user_seq, weight_kg, body_fat_pct, muscle_mass_kg, source, logged_at) VALUES (#{userSeq}, #{weightKg}, #{bodyFatPct}, #{muscleMassKg}, #{source}, #{loggedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_weight_log WHERE user_seq = #{userSeq} ORDER BY logged_at DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 1
